_comment: Snapshot of Virtuals' Agent Commerce Protocol (ACP) escrow on Base, read via Blockscout on 2026-06-19. Contract is the ERC-1967 proxy at 0x238E541BfefD82238730D00a2208E5497F1832E0 (implementation AgenticCommerceV3 at 0x8e86FbEf4a4c927561cb6447cEd77ffFbf3B77BC), live since 2026-04-08. jobsTotal is the latest JobCreated jobId (62882). The sample is the 30 consecutive JobCreated events #62848-#62882, classified by the event's evaluator field: 29 set evaluator == client (self-evaluation), 1 left it zero (which the contract resolves to the client), 0 named an independent third party.

modes.label: Client self-evaluates
modes.happy: Buyer approves the work → escrow releases to the provider.
modes.attack: The buyer rejects good work, keeps the off-chain deliverable, and reclaims the escrow.

modes.label: Independent evaluator
modes.exposed: nobody — if the evaluator is honest
modes.happy: Evaluator checks the deliverable against the agreement → escrow releases to the provider.
modes.attack: The evaluator catches the bad delivery and refunds the buyer — but a lazy or colluding evaluator just relocates the trust.

modes.label: No evaluator (auto-release)
modes.happy: Provider submits, the timer elapses → escrow releases to the provider.
modes.attack: The provider submits a worthless deliverable hash; the escrow releases anyway when nobody is in the chair to object.
